title: Publish the original qualified electrochemical Standard archive to NUGET_LOCAL
commitMessage: release: publish original electrochemical Standard archive to NUGET_LOCAL

contribution.summary: Deliver the RS174 electrochemical Standard archive to the qualified private feed with the shared immutable publisher after attempt allocation.
contribution.value: Expose the exact Math-owned Standard version requested for AURA A2-W02-C01-U-N. Bind the delivery to the original candidate, qualified publisher, both exact dependency archives and previous Standard archive. Record the observed local outcome in the DWF validation report.
debtChanges: RS175 succeeded at attempt 001, first pass, with seven publisher controls in a disposable feed.
Use the existing release authorization and preserve the original candidate bytes. An exact interrupted delivery can be observed after matching intent without overwriting the archive.
M1 remains done. M3, all 541 native nodes, backlog 0.1.122 and historical NuGet packages are retained. There is no completion transition.
Independent readback of the three physically published packages and three loaded DLLs remains pending. AURA historical reuse rights remain unestablished.
contribution.nextAction: After durable private publication, independently read the physically published Standard, Quantities and Expression archives and verify the three loaded DLL hashes for the AURA request.
